source.name: Amica Mutual Insurance: Amica, Boston Celtics Treat Special Olympics Rhode Island Athlete to VIP Experience at TD Garden
source.quote: Amica serves as the Exclusive Auto, Home and Life Insurance Partner of the Boston Celtics and became the team’s official jersey patch sponsor beginning with the 2024–25 season.
source.note: Amica's own 2026 press release confirming the ongoing jersey-patch partnership. The previous source (NBC Sports Boston) blocks automated access.

note: Jersey patch. Multi-year deal announced 2024-07-09; length and value not disclosed.
